about.title: Vernon Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Vernon is a working city more than a residential one. Trucks, delivery vans and shift traffic move through Santa Fe Avenue, District Boulevard and S Soto Street every day, and most of the people on those roads are heading to or from a job. When someone does not come home, the loss lands on a family that may live miles away, in another part of Los Angeles County or beyond. In 2025, Vernon recorded 223 injury collisions and 2 traffic deaths, according to public collision records. Behind each number is a household trying to make sense of what happened. California allows certain surviving relatives to bring a wrongful death claim, a civil case that stands apart from any criminal proceeding and asks who was responsible and what the family has lost. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that listens to your situation and connects you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death matters on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: What a Vernon Wrongful Death Attorney Helps You Sort Out

items.title: Who is allowed to file
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can confirm where you fall and whether other relatives need to be part of the same case.

items.title: The clock, and the exceptions to it
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death. If a public agency or government vehicle was involved, the window to give notice is much shorter, so timing matters early.

items.title: What the law lets a family recover
items.desc: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. This civil claim proceeds separately from any criminal charges.

items.question: My family member died on the job at a Vernon warehouse. Is that a wrongful death case?
items.answer: It can be, though it depends on who was at fault. Claims against an employer usually run through workers' compensation, but if a third party such as a trucking company, equipment maker or outside contractor contributed to the death, a separate wrongful death claim may be possible. An attorney can look at the facts and tell you which paths apply.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves on its own track, with a different standard of proof. Waiting for a criminal outcome can eat into the two-year deadline, so families often start the civil side while the criminal case is still pending.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge families anything?
items.answer: We do not. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm, and we simply connect you with an independent attorney who reviews wrongful death matters. The attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning there is no fee unless there is a recovery.
